profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
A dev focused on building reliable, user-centered solutions that solve real business problems. I enjoy working across the stack, turning complex requirements into simple, scalable systems.
 
My experience includes developing web + mobile applications, improving performance, and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products. I’m especially interested in opportunities where technology can make a meaningful impact, whether that’s improving user experience, increasing efficiency, or supporting better decision-making.
 
I value clean code, thoughtful design, and continuous learning. Always open to connecting with others!
